reviews.title: No Service Support
reviews.text: I was initially very excited to get this app and once downloaded, I was disappointed that all of the ‘splash’ of color that is shown in the advertising (referring to color coding calendar items by catagory) was not available. That to me is false advertising. A few days later I received an email advertising a discount if I upgraded to the pro version. Thinking that maybe that would give me the color coding I thought I was getting the first time around I signed up and paid. Absolutely no difference from the free version. OK, so there’s a glitch. I tried sending a message through “Contact Support” and my first message, as well as all consecutive messages got bounced back. I checked my Apple apps to see if maybe I hadn’t paid for the Pro version. Yes, I have. I went to the website to follow directions and they are either updated or wrong. So, I’m out the money, I can’t reach the company through the app and I’m frustrated. Can you hear me Tiny Calendar? I’m just trying to use the service I’m paying for.

reviews.title: Riddled with ads now
reviews.text: When I first downloaded this, it was great but over the last few months they’ve absolutely riddled it with ads. You cannot open it now, and it stops you from looking at your calendar without watching a lengthy ad. Really disappointing especially when you’re on the go and need to check. With so many other apps out there it’s not worth it. Pick something else.

reviews.title: Widget: Deleted Appointments Don’t Delete
reviews.text: I purchased this app so that I could consolidate all of my calendars (personal/work/family) in one easy to reference place — a widget on my screen.  Unfortunately, the widget (not the calendar) shows deleted content.  The whole point was to have a concise list of my ACTUAL day that I can have eyes on easily.  While I am at it a quick FYI — if you do not own a calendar (your work place), you can’t add it.

reviews.title: Functional and Annoying
reviews.text: The app itself does what I need to, and makes seeing my tasks for the month convenient. With that being said, when planning for the following months it quickly becomes annoying with all the constant ads.
